items.title: Live market data
items.notes: Pull live TSLA price, volume, and IV instead of using static slider inputs.

items.title: Options chain view
items.notes: Show expirations, strikes, bids/asks, volume, open interest, and greeks in one view.

items.title: Strategy presets
items.notes: Save common setups like bullish, bearish, income, and volatility presets for faster reuse.

items.title: Smart alert rules
items.notes: Alert on price, premium, delta, P&L, and time-to-expiry thresholds.

items.title: Export and share
items.notes: Export strategy snapshots as a shareable image or JSON summary.

items.title: Mobile polish
items.notes: Improve touch controls, spacing, and chart readability on smaller screens.
